Title: Registration page is displayed successfully
Description: Check the initial registration page view to ensure all main components appear properly.
Preconditions: User is not logged in. || Browser can access the internet.
Steps: Open the JobStreet Indonesia registration page. || Observe all key UI components on the page.
ExpectedResult: JobStreet logo is visible. || Registration page title is clear. || Sign-up buttons for Google, Facebook, and Apple are visible. || Email field and send code button are visible. || Help link, sign-in link, employer link, and legal footer are visible. || No overlapping, clipped, or broken elements.

Title: Are you looking for employees link routes to employer area
Description: Check whether the employer link directs users to the correct recruiter page.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Click the Are you looking for employees link.
ExpectedResult: User is redirected to the correct employer/recruiter page or domain. || Target page loads successfully without errors.

Title: Sign in link routes user to login page
Description: Ensure the Sign in link opens the job seeker login page.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Click the Sign in link below the form.
ExpectedResult: User is redirected to the job seeker login page. || Login form is displayed and usable.

Title: Help link is accessible from registration page
Description: Check whether users can open the Help page from the registration page.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Click the Help link.
ExpectedResult: Help page or help center opens successfully. || Help content is relevant to account or registration.

Title: Legal footer links can be opened
Description: Verify all legal links in the footer are active and route to the correct pages.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Click Security and Privacy link. || Return to registration page. || Click Terms and Conditions link. || Return to registration page. || Click Protect yourself online link. || Return to registration page. || Click Contact link.
ExpectedResult: Each link opens the correct page. || No broken links and no 404/500 pages.

Title: User can request sign-in code using a new valid email
Description: Ensure a valid email for a new account can be used to request a sign-in code.
Preconditions: Registration page is open. || Email is not yet registered or follows system rules for new registration.
Steps: Enter a valid email in the Email address field. || Click Send me a sign-in code via email button.
ExpectedResult: Email validation passes. || Sign-in code request is processed. || System shows a success message that the code has been sent. || User is directed to code verification step or next instructions.

Title: Email with leading or trailing spaces is normalized correctly
Description: Check whether the system trims spaces before validating the email.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Enter an email with spaces at the beginning and end. || Click send sign-in code button.
ExpectedResult: System removes unnecessary spaces before validation. || If email format is valid after normalization, process continues successfully.

Title: Empty email is rejected with a clear validation message
Description: Ensure email field cannot be empty and the error message is clear.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Leave email field empty. || Click send sign-in code button.
ExpectedResult: Request is not sent to backend. || Validation message that email is required is clearly shown. || Focus stays on or returns to the email field.

Title: Invalid email format is rejected
Description: Check whether invalid email format is rejected before processing.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Enter an invalid email format. || Click send sign-in code button.
ExpectedResult: Request is not processed. || Email validation error message is shown and easy to understand.

Title: Registered email is handled according to business rules
Description: Ensure registered emails follow the correct product flow without exposing sensitive information.
Preconditions: Registration page is open. || A registered email is available.
Steps: Enter a registered email. || Click send sign-in code button.
ExpectedResult: System provides a safe and clear response according to product design. || If existing accounts can continue passwordless login, code can still be sent. || If existing accounts must go to login, system shows proper instruction. || Response does not reveal sensitive data beyond business needs.

Title: Pressing Enter in email field triggers correct action
Description: Check whether Enter key runs the same action as clicking send code button.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Enter a valid email in email field. || Press Enter on keyboard.
ExpectedResult: Submit action runs the same as clicking send sign-in code button. || No duplicate submissions or unexpected behavior.

Title: Network failure during sign-in code request is handled properly
Description: Ensure network issues do not cause unclear errors or loss of user input.
Preconditions: Registration page is open. || Simulate internet disconnection or backend timeout/failure.
Steps: Enter a valid email. || Click send sign-in code button while connection is unstable.
ExpectedResult: System shows a user-friendly and actionable error message. || User can retry after connection recovers. || Email input is not lost without reason.

Title: Registration or login via Google succeeds
Description: Check Google login/registration flow until user returns to the application.
Preconditions: Registration page is open. || Valid Google account is available.
Steps: Click Continue with Google button. || Select a valid Google account and approve consent if prompted. || Complete authentication.
ExpectedResult: Google authentication popup/page opens correctly. || After successful authentication, user returns to JobStreet. || Account is created or user is logged in based on existing data. || User is directed to onboarding, dashboard, or profile page.

Title: Registration or login via Facebook succeeds
Description: Ensure Facebook authentication flow completes smoothly and user returns to JobStreet.
Preconditions: Registration page is open. || Valid Facebook account is available.
Steps: Click Continue with Facebook button. || Complete authentication on Facebook.
ExpectedResult: Facebook authentication runs successfully. || User returns to JobStreet as logged in user or with newly created account.

Title: Registration or login via Apple succeeds
Description: Check Apple login/registration flow, including hide my email option.
Preconditions: Registration page is open. || Valid Apple ID is available.
Steps: Click Continue with Apple button. || Complete Apple authentication including hide my email option if available.
ExpectedResult: Apple authentication runs successfully. || System can still create or identify the account correctly even when email relay is used.

Title: Cancelling social login does not cause broken account or hanging state
Description: Ensure cancelling social login does not freeze the page or create a partial account.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Click one of the social login buttons. || Close popup or cancel authentication from provider side.
ExpectedResult: User returns to registration page without JavaScript errors or freeze. || No partial account is created without full consent/authentication. || Informational message appears if needed.

Title: Valid email sign-in code can be verified
Description: Check whether a valid sign-in code can be used to complete login or registration.
Preconditions: Sign-in code has been sent to user email. || User is on code verification page.
Steps: Open the user email inbox. || Retrieve the valid sign-in code. || Enter code on verification page. || Confirm verification.
ExpectedResult: Valid code is accepted. || Account is created or login session is activated. || User is redirected to the next page to start applying for jobs or complete profile.

Title: Incorrect sign-in code is rejected
Description: Ensure system rejects incorrect code and still allows retry.
Preconditions: User is on code verification page.
Steps: Enter an incorrect code. || Submit verification.
ExpectedResult: Verification fails. || Clear error message is shown. || User can retry while still within allowed attempt limit.

Title: Expired sign-in code is rejected and user can request new code
Description: Check whether expired code is rejected and user can still request a new code.
Preconditions: User has a code that has passed validity period.
Steps: Enter an expired code. || Submit verification. || Select resend code option if available.
ExpectedResult: System rejects expired code. || Expired-code message is shown. || User can request or receive a new code.

Title: Resend sign-in code generates a new valid code
Description: Ensure resend feature sends a new code that can be used successfully.
Preconditions: User is on code verification page. || Resend feature is available based on cooldown.
Steps: Click resend code after cooldown ends. || Open latest email. || Use latest code for verification.
ExpectedResult: New code is sent to user email. || Latest code can be used successfully. || Previous code becomes invalid if system rule applies.

Title: After successful registration user can continue to onboarding or profile
Description: Check post-registration destination so user lands on the correct next page.
Preconditions: Registration or login succeeds via email or social auth.
Steps: Complete registration successfully. || Observe destination page after success.
ExpectedResult: User session is active. || User is redirected to relevant page to start applying, complete profile, or open dashboard. || User name or login indicator is shown if designed that way.

Title: Field labels and error messages are clearly readable
Description: Check clarity of labels, action buttons, and validation messages in the form.
Preconditions: Registration page is open.
Steps: Observe email field label, action button text, and displayed validation messages.
ExpectedResult: Labels match controlled inputs. || Error messages are specific, concise, and easy to understand. || Text and component contrast is sufficient for comfortable reading.

Title: All main copy on page is consistently in Bahasa Indonesia
Description: Check whether all main text on the page consistently uses Bahasa Indonesia.
Preconditions: User accesses Indonesian locale.
Steps: Open registration page and review all main text on screen.
ExpectedResult: Texts such as register, email address, help, sign in, and CTA buttons are in Bahasa Indonesia. || No inconsistent language mix except for brand name or social provider names.
